scope: Pinned character-source helper Amount callbacks for HealBonusMod, ReactBonusMod, and CooldownMod. Go retains modifier creation, triggers, gates, expiry, recipients, and state mutation.

aggregateSharedStatus.healBonus: HealBonus() aggregate read and 1 + HealBonus() + HealInfo.Bonus are shared; each HealBonusMod.Amount below is not individually shared.
aggregateSharedStatus.reactBonus: ReactBonus() aggregate sum is shared; each ReactBonusMod.Amount below is not individually shared.
aggregateSharedStatus.cooldownReduction: Aggregate cooldown factor and trunc(duration * factor) are shared; each CooldownMod.Amount below is not individually shared.

items.expression: c6 active and recipient is active character: 0.15 + (moonsign >= 2 ? 0.20 : 0); otherwise 0
items.b4A7Difference: Formula retained. b4 uses AttackTagIsLunar; a7 uses AttackTag.IsLunar(), whose fixed-source tag classification is authoritative.
items.goGatesAndSideEffects: C6 status and active-recipient gates; lunar, EC, Bloom, or Bountiful Core tags. No formula-side mutation.
items.sharedStatus: Amount not individually shared; aggregate reaction sum is shared.

items.expression: h=min(MaxHP/1000,50); Aggravate/Spread when Catalyzed: h*0.008; Bloom/Hyperbloom/Burgeon/Burning: h*0.02; DirectLunarBloom: h*0.007; else 0
items.b4A7Difference: No material formula difference found.
items.goGatesAndSideEffects: A4 required; active recipient receives timed mod. Go selects CatalyzedType/AttackTag and owns duration.
items.sharedStatus: Amount not individually shared. Separate fixed Baizhu A1 Heal StatMod is already shared by rule char-baizhu-baizhu-a1-heal-bonus-heal-0p2.

items.expression: action in {Skill,Burst,SpecialSkill} ? -0.15 : 0
items.b4A7Difference: b4 includes Skill and Burst; a7 adds SpecialSkill.
items.goGatesAndSideEffects: C2 required; recipient is active character during infusion; expiry duration uses Skill talent table.
items.sharedStatus: Aggregate cooldown factor is shared; per-mod action branch is not.

items.expression: AttackTag.IsLunar() ? burstBuff[TalentLvlBurst] : 0
items.b4A7Difference: b4 AttackTagIsLunar helper replaced by a7 AttackTag.IsLunar(); use pinned-version tag classification.
items.goGatesAndSideEffects: Burst applies timed party modifier; Go owns timer/tag gate. Debug logging only.
items.sharedStatus: Talent-table/tag-gated Amount is not individually shared.

items.b4A7Difference: No material difference found.
items.goGatesAndSideEffects: C6 path selects incoming heal bonus when active recipient HP is at/below source threshold; 120-frame expiry; optional debug log.
items.sharedStatus: Aggregate healing formula shared; this Amount is not.

items.b4A7Difference: No material difference found.
items.goGatesAndSideEffects: C4 trigger grants to active character if HP ratio < 0.5; 48-frame expiry. Separate ER branch checks Energy/EnergyMax < 0.5.
items.sharedStatus: Aggregate healing formula shared; this Amount is not.

items.expression: Amped ? 0.40 * hexereiA1Bonus() : 0; helper is 1.75 if Hexerei and team Hexerei count >= 2, else 1
items.b4A7Difference: No material callback difference found.
items.goGatesAndSideEffects: A1 and black burst mode; white mode deletes modifier. Amped gate and live team-count read remain in Go.

items.expression: Moonsign >= 2 and tag in {DirectLunarCharged,ReactionLunarCharge} ? 0.20 : 0
items.b4A7Difference: Amount unchanged. Separate event subscription changes OnLunarReactionAttack in b4 to OnSpecialReactionAttack in a7.
items.goGatesAndSideEffects: A1, event, and Moonsign gates remain native.

items.expression: burstActive ? min(curFanfare,maxQFanfare) * burstFanfareHBRatio[TalentLvlBurst] : 0
items.b4A7Difference: No material difference found.
items.goGatesAndSideEffects: Party recipients; Go owns burst status and fanfare state. Coefficient table is pinned source data.
items.sharedStatus: Aggregate healing formula shared; fanfare/talent Amount is not.

items.expression: ns=min(getTeamNightsoul()+c2BonusPoints(ns),150+c2CapIncrease()); Swirl Pyro/Hydro/Electro/Cryo or EC => 0.015*ns; LunarCharged/StellarSwirl => 0.002*ns; else 0
items.b4A7Difference: a7 adds StellarSwirl tags to the 0.002*ns branch; absent in b4.
items.goGatesAndSideEffects: A1 and Nightsoul Blessing; C2 adds points and raises cap. Team stack read/log remain in Go.

items.expression: c1 active and LunarCharged tag ? min(TotalATK/100*0.025,0.50) : 0
items.b4A7Difference: Amount unchanged. Separate subscription changes OnLunarReactionAttack in b4 to OnSpecialReactionAttack in a7.
items.goGatesAndSideEffects: C1 state plus DirectLunarCharged/ReactionLunarCharge tags. Source has unresolved hitlag-scope TODO; do not treat timing as verified.

items.expression: Bloom tag ? burstDmgBonus[TalentLvlBurst] : 0

items.expression: Bloom tag ? 0.60 : 0
items.b4A7Difference: No material difference found.

items.expression: DirectLunarBloom tag ? 0.40 : 0
items.b4A7Difference: No material difference found.

items.expression: dreamDrifter active and not Amped/Catalyzed; traditional Swirl => swirlDMG[TalentLvlSkill]*EM*0.01; StellarSwirl => stellarSwirlDMG[TalentLvlSkill]*EM*0.01; else 0

items.sharedStatus: Neither talent/EM Amount branch is individually shared.

items.goGatesAndSideEffects: Hexerei/team-count setup gate; excludes Mona recipient. On matching callback read, Go clears astralGlowStacks before returning its computed value; preserve this side effect in Go.

implementationBoundaries: 025 character-modifier bridge covers fixed StatMod/AttackMod vector slots, not HealBonusMod, ReactBonusMod, or CooldownMod Amount callbacks.
The aggregate helper outputs already captured/shared do not establish sharing of each modifier's Amount formula.
A next bridge should capture one helper Amount at its actual Go read with source commit, modifier key, holder, recipient, and numeric state inputs; Go must keep trigger/lifecycle and side effects.
Mona Astral Glow clears stacks inside the Go callback. Nilou's source TODO and Ineffa's hitlag TODO remain unresolved and must not be described as validated game behavior.
statusScope: Historical source inventory before 030–033 character-scalar implementation; item sharedStatus fields describe that earlier state.
corrections: Ifa is absent from pinned b4 and present only in a7; its earlier b4/a7 comparison was incorrect.
Baizhu original 0.02 vs 0.007 distinction was correct: empty Go switch cases do not fall through.
